ITA-5.76.151 viriktasya nasya vyāpadaḥ विरिक्तस्य नस्य व्यापदः
Condition due to inhalation therapy administered to person who has taken purgation therapy
A condition characterized by affliction of the sense organs.

viruddhāhāraḥ, viruddhānnam विरुद्धाहारः/ विरुद्धान्नम्
Incompatible foods
Types of food which should not be eaten together, examples of incompatible combinations include examples of incompatible combinations include milk and salt, milk and fish, honey and ghee in equal amounts.

ITA-5.74.5 viruddhānnabhojanam/ viruddhāhāraḥ विरुद्धान्नभोजनम् / विरुद्धाहारः
Disorder due to intake of incompatible foods
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: impotence; blindness; spreading cellulitis/ erysipelas; signs of dakodara; blisters; insanity; anal fistula; syncope or swooning; insanity; abdominal distension; choking sensation in throat; clinical features of pāṇḍu; āmaviśa; kilāsaḥ; skin disease; grahaṇī dosha; oedema; amlapitta; fever; cold catarrh; congenital anamolies in offsprings; death.

virūḍhadhānāḥ, virūḍhadhakaḥ विरूढधानाः, विरूढाढकः
Sprouted grains
Varieties of sprouted grains such as green gram or chickpea.

ITA-9.2.70 virecanakarma विरे चनकर्म
Therapeutic purgation
A therapeutic process for the controlled induction of purgation along with a series of pre- and postintervention measures.

ITA-9.6.212 virecanakarma विरे चनकर्म
Removal of foreign body by purgation
The removal of a loosely impacted foreign body by purgation.

.14 virecana-karma, recana-karma विरेचन-कर्म, रेचनकर्म
Therapeutic purgation
A therapeutic purgation to eliminate vitiated dosha which are drawn to the stomach by preparatory panchakarma procedures.

ITA-5.76.51 virecanakarmacikitsāpacāraḥ विरेचनकर्म-चिकित्सापचारः
Condition due to improper purgation therapy

ITA-5.76.54 mithyāvirecanam/ virecanamithyāyogaḥ मिथ्याविरेचनम्/ विरेचनमिथ्यायोगः
Condition of improper purgation therapy
A condition characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: heaviness of body; dysentery; cutting type of pain in anus; abdominal distension; heaviness of head; vayu not moving downwards; increase in severity of disease.

ITA-5.76.71 virecanavyāpat विरेचनव्यापत्
Condition of improper administration of purgative therapy

ITA-5.76.52 virecanātiyogaḥ विरेचनातियोगः
Signs of excessive administration of purgation therapy

ITA-5.76.53 virecanāyogaḥ विरेचनायोगः
Condition of insufficient purgation

ITA-1.9.3.7.7 vīrudha वीरुध
Small plant
A herb or shrub, e.g. country mallow (Sida cordifolia L.) (bala).

.1 vīryam, śaktiḥ वीर्यम्, शक्तिः
Potency
The innate quality of a substance, its ability to effectuate a change, or act on the body and mind. Broadly categorized into two categories: hot and cold potency.

ITA-9.9.45 vīryavāhinīsirāchedanajanyaklaibyam वीर्यवाहिनीसिराछेदनजन्यक्लैब्यम्
Traumatic impotency
Impotency due to trauma to the ejaculatory tract.
